description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different models, comparing their relative effectiveness. The horizontal axis lists the model categories, labeled as "Standard", "Self-RAG", "FactTune", "CInGS (w/)" and "CInGS", in a fixed order without any apparent sorting. The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model category is represented by a single bar, colored differently: "Standard" is brown with a value of approximately 52, "Self-RAG" is beige with a value of around 53, "FactTuneCInGS (w/)" is green with a value of about 51, "CInGS (w/)" is dark blue with a value of roughly 54, and "CInGS" is blue with a value of approximately 59. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
